title: Oliver's band breaks up; Snowden, Chick Webb and Jelly Roll Morton
summary: The Oliver band lost the Cotton Club to Ellington. Barnes stayed in New York five years, played with Snowden and Webb and joined Jelly Roll Morton on Louis Russell's recommendation.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
